integrity: The proof is analytic. The included numerical program is a regression check and is not used as a substitute for the infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem treats cyclic grids N=nm with m>=4 and endpoint ell^1/ell^infinity norms; arbitrary grid ratios and interior ell^p norms are not determined.
title: Exact cyclic decimation law for de la Vallée Poussin endpoint norms
